papers.title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
papers.desc: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors.

papers.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
papers.desc: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem.

papers.title: A GPU-Parallel Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.desc: GPU-parallel simulation provides abundant robot interaction, but existing benchmarks rarely combine this scale with heterogeneous manipulation tasks and standardized multi-task RL evaluation.

papers.title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
papers.desc: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights.

papers.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
papers.desc: Recent AI systems have made rapid progress in scientific discovery when given well-defined metrics, but whether they can autonomously undertake open-ended scientific discovery remains unclear.

papers.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
papers.desc: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas.

papers.title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative block denoising, and multi-branch speculative decoding accelerates this process by verifying a main branch together with multiple draft branches in a single forward pass.

papers.title: Incidental information contaminates patient notes and disrupts clinical reasoning in large language models
papers.desc: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly relied upon to support ambient documentation and clinical reasoning.

papers.title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
papers.desc: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve.

papers.title: MIRA: A Musical Intent Refinement Agent for Aligning Text-to-Music Generation with User Intent
papers.desc: Text-to-music systems produce increasingly convincing audio, yet evaluation reveals little about whether the result matches user intent.

papers.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
papers.desc: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens.

papers.title: Skill Constellations: Tracing the Supply Chain of Agent Skills on GitHub
papers.desc: Agent skills are SKILL.md instructions and scripts that AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex run with the permissions of their user.

papers.title: Predicting Cable Dynamics with Physical Attention Bias
papers.desc: Learned simulators for deformable linear objects (DLOs) such as cables have to predict the motion of cables they were not trained on and stay stable over long rollouts.

papers.title: Behavioral Persistence and Incomplete Functional Transfer of Co-evolved Communication in Evolutionary Robotics
papers.desc: This work evaluates the direct transfer of a co-evolved communication protocol from a 2D simulation to a 3D physical environment, without retraining the network weights.

papers.title: Evaluating the Transfer of Co-Evolved Communication from 2D to 3D Simulation
papers.desc: This work examines the transfer of a co-evolved communication mechanism between two robotic agents from a discrete two-dimensional (2D) simulator to a three-dimensional simulator with real physics (3D).
